evidence.detail: noTablesorter = 'table.live' — only live tables are excluded; table.calendar is not excluded
$(selector).not(noTablesorter).tablesorter({}) — applies tablesorter to all main tables including table.calendar
calendar table has no data-text sort hints; Date column renders <time> elements whose visible text is hidden/repeated by pd.js line 407, making sort nonsensical

triage.fix_sketch: In shared_web/static/js/pd.js line 130, change `var noTablesorter = 'table.live';` to `var noTablesorter = 'table.live, table.calendar';`. This is a one-line change that removes tablesorter from the tournament calendar on / and /tournaments/ without affecting any other tables.
triage.notes: Single character-class addition in pd.js; no template or backend changes needed. Confirmed the issue is still present: tournamentcalendar.mustache has no sort-data attributes and pd.js hides repeated month cells, making the sort order meaningless.
